# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please report it responsibly.

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Instead, send an email to **security@graphcompose.io** with the following details:

- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce the issue
- Any potential impact or severity assessment
- Suggested fix, if available

## Response Timeline

You can expect an initial response within **72 hours** of your report. We will work with you to understand and validate the issue before taking appropriate action.

## Disclosure

We ask that you give us reasonable time to address the vulnerability before publicly disclosing it. We will coordinate with you on an appropriate disclosure timeline once the fix is in place.
